name: Matsukaze Rena
source:
When working as an office lady 3 years ago she fell in love with and married Raita, now Shouta's step mother she has quit her job and is a full time housewife.

She has a gentle and motherly nature and dotes on and pampers Shouta, she eventually started to let him suck her breast to due to him starving for motherly affection.
Due to Shouta's request she let him suck her breast every day and one day when Raita found out he kicked Shouta out the house.
